(2) The scene transitions to a series of close-up shots showing numerous small black insects crawling on various surfaces. They appear on the beige fabric of a tent and a clear plastic cup. The background remains consistent with the previous outdoor street scene under flat lighting. (6) More close-up footage reveals the black insects on a grey textured pole and crawling on a person's lower leg near the strap of a black sandal. The focus is extremely tight on the insects' movements against the skin and metal, shot in an outdoor daylight setting. (7) The setting shifts to a large outdoor wave pool or surf park. The man talks to a second male character who has blonde hair, a beard, and is wearing a brown baseball cap. They stand near a glass railing overlooking turquoise water where people are surfing. (8) The blonde man laughs while looking through the viewfinder of a Sony professional camera mounted on a tripod. He wears a white t-shirt with red lettering. The background shows a sprawling artificial wave pool and distant high-rise apartment buildings under a cloudy sky.
